item.title: WA’s population set to hit 4 million by 2043, new report finds
item.description: Western Australia has officially crossed a defining milestone. In 2024, the state ticked over three million residents — reaching 3,009,838 people in December, before climbing again to 3,043,731 by June 2025. Now, a major new report from the Bankwest Curtin Economics Centre (BCEC) suggests that milestone is just the beginning. According to its latest projections,…
